Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", new ConversionOptions { HiddenContent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<HiddenContent>("\"Reachable\"", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
